title: Optimal Guarantees for Online Selection Over Time
abstract: arXiv:2408.11224v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prophet inequalities are a cornerstone in optimal stopping and online decision-making. Traditionally, they involve the sequential observation of $n$ non-negative independent random variables and face irrevocable accept-or-reject choices. The goal is to provide policies that provide a good competitive ratio against the optimal offline solution that can access all the values upfront---the so-called prophet value. In the \emph{prophet inequality over time problem} (POT), the decision-maker can commit to an accepted value for $\tau$ units of time, during which no new values can be accepted. This creates a trade-off between the duration of commitment and the opportunity to capture potentially higher future values. translated_title: 随时间在线选择的最优保证
translated_abstract: 先知不等式是最优停止与在线决策领域的基石。传统上，它涉及对 $n$ 个非负独立随机变量的顺序观测，并面临不可撤销的接受或拒绝选择。其目标是提供能够相对于可预先获取所有值的最优离线解（即所谓的先知值）具有良好竞争比的策略。在“随时间的先知不等式问题”（POT）中，决策者需要对一个被接受的值承诺 $\tau$ 个时间单位，在此期间不能接受新的值。这在承诺的持续时间与捕获潜在更高未来值的机会之间产生了权衡。在这项工作中，我们在POT的独立同分布（IID）设置下，为单阈值算法和最优动态规划策略提供了可能达到的最优最坏情况竞争比。我们展示了一个单阈值算法，其能够达到……
tldr: 本文在独立同分布设置下，为随时间的先知不等式问题（POT）中的单阈值算法和最优动态规划策略给出了最优的最坏情况竞争比保证。
en_tdlr: This paper provides optimal worst-case competitive ratio guarantees for single-threshold algorithms and the optimal dynamic programming policy in the IID setting of the prophet inequality over time (POT) problem.
